d:
Halloween came early at Perth Zoo in Western Australia! Dingoes Sunny and Luna wrestle to get a closer look at their pumpkin treat, while Goodfellow’s tree kangaroo Muku takes a more relaxed approach. A playful meerkat mob also joins the Halloween fun. The zoo says these specially prepared pumpkin treats are part of its animal enrichment activities, designed to keep animals active, engaged and curious while supporting their natural instincts and overall welfare.
